title: gRPC API Testing: Companion Scripts
author: Mathias Paulenko
requirements: grpcio 1.60+ and grpcio-tools (for the in-process mock test)
description: grpcurl commands, a buf breaking-change setup and a minimal in-process gRPC mock test for validating unary and streaming RPCs against the payflow ledger example used in the guide.
titleEs: Testing de APIs gRPC: Scripts Companion
descriptionEs: Comandos grpcurl, configuracion de buf para breaking changes y un test mock in-process de gRPC para validar RPC unary y streaming contra el ejemplo de ledger payflow de la guia.
